faq.question: Q1. What is the MoHFW Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare for hiring 1 Consultant (Clinical Establishments) for the Secretariat for National Council for Clinical Establishments on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post of Consultant (Clinical Establishments).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to send applications by email is 22 October 2026 (within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement on the website).

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS or BDS degree. Post-graduation in Public Health or Community Medicine is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the consultant post?
faq.answer: The age limit depends on post-qualification experience: up to 35 years (≤ 2 years experience), up to 45 years (> 2 years experience), up to 55 years (≥ 7 years experience), and up to 60 years (> 12 years experience).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this post?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can send their application along with biodata and copies of qualification and experience documents via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called to appear for an interview before a selection committee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the monthly salary offered?
faq.answer: The starting remuneration ranges from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 1,20,000 per month depending on the post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely on a contract basis for a period of one year (extendable by one more year depending on performance), and candidates shall not claim regularization.
